basic_profile.bio: I'm a 22-year-old university student from Halifax, Nova Scotia, majoring in English literature with a minor in East Asian studies. I've been fascinated by manga and anime since high school and love exploring their cultural significance and narrative styles. In my free time, I enjoy reading manga, watching anime, and occasionally dabbling in creative writing. I'm a night owl, often online during late hours, usually from 10 PM to 2 AM. Currently single, I spend a lot of time with my cat, Neko. I'm also interested in video game reviews, especially those by Joseph Anderson.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge predominantly comes from self-study and university coursework. I've taken several classes on Japanese culture and literature, which have deepened my understanding of manga and anime. I also follow various content creators and educators online to broaden my perspectives.
